content.title: Chapter 58 - MUNICIPAL COURT — Sec. 58-8. - Reserved.
content.summary:
Editor's note—
Ord. No. 4830
, § 2, adopted December 5, 2022, repealed § 58-8, which pertained to compliance with
               process; required and derived from § 1-24(a) of the 1960 Code; § 18-12 of the 1981
               Code.
